correctness.rationale: The definition forbids a third distinct edge joining endpoints of two selected edges; selected edges need not be disjoint. Reconstructed exact direct edge-conflict predicates and the six legal same-column masks. For n>=7 only separations 0,1,2 matter, yielding 17 pair states and 37 shifts. A 0/-1 potential transforms the weight 1-|mask| to nonnegative deficiencies 0,1 with zero-cost matrix B0 (24 transitions) and unit-cost B1 (13). Independently multiplied full integer 17x17 matrices to establish B0^8=B0^2 and exact tr(B1 B0^(j-1)) for j=1..8 as (1,1,4,2,4,6,2,2); direct digraph inspection gives unique zero-deficiency 6-cycle. Trace recurrence counts all zero-deficiency and exactly-one-deficiency closed cyclic words, proving all n formulas. Independent tests checked third-edge geometry and optimum counts n=7..30. All-order conclusion uses exact finite matrix identity, not extrapolation from bounded n.
residual_risks: Only simple cyclic prisms n>=7; n<=6, wider ladders and non-optimal packings are excluded.
